params.amountReceived: The USDC amount actually received (as reported by BaaS webhook)

acknowledgeBuyer(bytes32).notice: Records buyer acknowledgement. In V1 admin calls this on behalf of         the buyer after verifying a signed email confirmation.         In V2 the buyer signs directly with their wallet.

adminRegisterInvoice(bytes32,address,uin.notice: Admin registers an invoice before it can be funded.

approvePartialRepayment(bytes32,uint256).notice: Admin calls this when BaaS webhook reports a partial payment         that is >= 50% of the required amount.         Proportional lender capital is released immediately.         Remaining shortfall enters a CURE_WINDOW cure period.

approveRepayment(bytes32).notice: Called by admin (or oracle relay) after BaaS webhook confirms full payment         and the 24h buffer has elapsed with no block.         For partial payments use approvePartialRepayment().

blockSettlement(bytes32,string).notice: Admin blocks a pending auto-settlement within the 24h buffer (L4).         Moves invoice to Disputed for manual resolution.

buyerRepay(bytes32).notice: Buyer repays directly in USDC — instant trustless settlement.         A 0.5% fee discount is applied: the contract accepts         `advanceAmount + lenderYield + discountedFee` from the buyer.         No admin step required. No 24h buffer.

claimPayout().notice: Any party (seller, lender, admin) claims their allocated USDC.

claimRefund(bytes32).notice: Lender calls this after repaymentDeadline if buyer has not paid.         Returns principal only; yield is forfeited on default.         Requires no admin action — the safety net is trustless.

cureShortfall(bytes32).notice: Admin calls this when the buyer cures the shortfall within the cure window.

fundInvoice(bytes32,address,uint256).notice: Lender funds an invoice. Requires buyer acknowledgement (L1).
